items.title: VeilFarers Corebook
items.description: Editorial 12.05 release. The authoritative downloadable Corebook for the current portal release, with the unified two-Slot multiclass model, the Sleeping Dormant Domain, and corrected navigation.

items.title: VeilFarers Keeper's Companion
items.description: Editorial 12.04 release for Keepers: session preparation, running VeilFarers, and the Keeper-facing consent-based Severance Event. Hearts in the Void is maintained as a separate adventure.

items.title: Hearts in the Void
items.description: Standalone VeilFarers adventure 1.0, aligned to the 12.04 canon. This deliverable is independent from the Keeper's Companion.

items.title: VeilFarers: Alien Species
items.description: Editorial 12.04 alien species and Keeper-facing lore supplement, with a dynamic Contents page.

items.title: VeilFarers Starship Sheet
items.description: Two-page printable starship sheet: shield arcs and Armor Slots, Hull and Heat tracks, ship Systems and Weapons, Sensor Lock, Drive Modes, class stats and range bands.

items.title: VeilFarers Fillable Character Sheet
items.description: Editable two-page physical character sheet with 186 fillable form fields.
